marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 脆弱也沒關係, 好好療傷的溫柔練習 : 從接納到拯救自己，給總是受傷的你 = 상처는 한 번만 받겠습니다 = I Will Never Get Hurt Again | Cui ruo ye mei guan xi, hao hao liao shang de wen rou lian xi : cong jie na dao zheng jiu zi ji, gei zong shi shou shang de ni = 상처는 한 번만 받겠습니다 = I Will Never Get Hurt Again

In this book, the author guides us through the landscape of a wounded heart, sharing his personal journey of healing in everyday life. Through reading, traveling, exercising, and other daily routines, he helps us see how to rediscover the essence of life, learn to accept ourselves, and live a life no longer ruled by the fear of being hurt. By simply living well and paying attention to the little things that matter—whether it’s washing the dishes, brewing a cup of coffee, taking a walk, or reading a book—we can let life itself heal us. Each day becomes a chance to live in the most comfortable, genuine way possible
